runs.name: people-snapshot-reader-oversize-v1
runs.note: A synthetic 33 MiB credit citation published through the service is returned completely and bypasses retention.

behavior: Reuse only the last complete person body within its exact live database-enforced read-only repeatable-read transaction.
Replay all body-local owner and artist requirements and ordered issues. Each query retrieves its actual hits, limits, negative scope and final read set.
Changing limits, eviction, closure overflow and encoded retention above 32 MiB use ordinary complete reads. The optimization introduces no semantic refusal or truncated facts.
Source proposal preparation and each machine publication cohort dispose their own reader inside the original snapshot.
No public API, schema, policy, semantic version, Work hash or publication-capacity changes.
verification: Exact cached/ordinary snapshot equality across query reasons, overlapping candidates, empty results and normalized limits.
Missing owners, missing catalog clocks, malformed actor evidence and incomplete closures retain blocking diagnostics.
Review changes stay on the original snapshot and become visible in a new snapshot.
Reader lifetime, rollback, commit, disposal, cancellation and oversize bypass.
Source resolution, publication and people acceptance regression paths.
review: Fresh independent correctness and separate readability/simplifier reviews found no issues.
limits: These results do not measure throughput, process memory savings or matching accuracy.
Full-size publication, migration58, full suite, independent evaluation and catalog backfill/rollout remain required.
